text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When asked about her next goal, Satono 
Diamond requested the Classic Triple
Crown 
route, believing it to be the royal road 
befitting the achievements of a "renowned 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her resolve is unwavering. For she was 
born to break the curse of the Satono 
clan, and for that, she had received 
immense support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to live up to the expectations 
of the family that supported her.
She made 
a resolute vow that she would definitely 
win a GⅠ, break the Satono jinx, and 
achieve her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And currently, Kitasan Black was 
challenging the Classic Triple Crown
path. 
There would surely be a lot to learn from 
her races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking that as a reference, let's push 
forward with preparations for the
upcoming 
Satsuki Sho alongside Satono Diamond!
